title: IC-to-Manager Transition: Skill Ladder, Mentor Journal & 90-Day Onboard Sprint
body:
Purpose:
This working doc defines a mentor-led, evidence-first onboarding and calibration pack for individual contributors promoted or hired into first-line manager roles. It combines a concise hiring plan, an interview rubric tailored to promo hires, a skill ladder snapshot, and a daily mentor journal template plus a 90-day sprint checklist focused on measurable leadership outcomes.

Scope and audience:
- People Ops & Hiring Managers: use for leveling, offers, and handoff.
- Mentors & Buddies: daily/weekly prompts, evidence capture.
- Hiring panel & interviewers: rubric and suggested probes.
- New manager: personal growth map and reflection log.

Quick summary (one-line):
A reproducible, low-friction process to ensure IC->Manager transitions are consistent, supported, and measurable across the first 90 days.

Hiring plan snapshot (for internal use):
- Role signals: has led projects end-to-end, coached peers informally, shown stakeholder influence, basic roadmap ownership.
- Minimum bar for promotion: documented 2+ examples of coaching, one cross-functional influence story, and a short plan for first 90 days (500–800 words).
- Interview loop (4 rounds): 1) Leadership case & values (panel), 2) Operational judgment + prioritization (hiring manager), 3) Coaching micro-sim (peer/mentor), 4) Reference + culture fit (HR).
- Offer contingencies: manager development plan and mentor assignment included in offer letter.

Interview rubric (score 1–5, capture evidence):
- Coaching & Feedback (1 poor — 5 excellent): probes: describe a time you gave corrective feedback; what was the follow-up? Evidence to collect: feedback note, outcome timeline.
- Prioritization & Tradeoffs (1–5): probe: you have 3 competing requests + team capacity down 20% — what's first? Evidence: decision memo example, metrics used.
- Stakeholder Management (1–5): probe: how do you handle disagreement with a PM? Evidence: email thread, escalation notes.
- Execution & Delegation (1–5): probe: explain a time you delegated a high-risk task. Evidence: role assignment, post-mortem.
- Growth Mindset & Learning (1–5): probe: how do you upskill your team? Evidence: training plan, outcomes.
- Culture & Values (1–5): probe: how do you model company principles as a manager?

Rubric guidance: capture 1–2 concrete artifacts per competency. A hiring scorecard should include top-3 risk signals (no concrete examples, inconsistent follow-up, inability to describe delegation) and top-3 strength signals (repeatable coaching method, measurable team outcome, cross-team influence).

Skill ladder snapshot (mapped to first 90 days priorities):
- Level 1 (Entry manager): 1) Running 1:1s, 2) Track team health metrics, 3) Triage blockers, 4) Partner with PM on one roadmap item.
- Level 2 (Developing): 1) Basic hiring/forecasting input, 2) Run retros + improvement experiments, 3) resolve cross-team tradeoffs, 4) evidence-backed performance conversations.
- Level 3 (Independent): 1) Own team roadmap and priorities, 2) shape hiring plan, 3) run calibration w/ other managers, 4) coach managers on operational excellence.

90-day sprint: mentor-led outcomes (owner = mentor + new manager)
- Day 0 (pre-start): set up manager account, invite to manager forum, assign mentor, define 90-day objective (OKR-lite), ensure hardware & access ready.
- Day 1 checklist (first week): 1) First 1:1 with mentor + template, 2) schedule recurring team 1:1s, 3) meet hiring manager to align expectations, 4) shadow payroll/HR flow.
- Week 1–2 (stabilize): deliverable: 30-day health snapshot (team headcount, blockers, 3 immediate wins). Mentor task: run a coaching micro-session.
- Day 30 deliverables: 1) 30-day reflections (what's working, what's broken), 2) 30-day hiring needs note, 3) baseline team KPI dashboard (owner: manager). Mentor task: run calibration meeting with hiring manager.
- Day 60 deliverables: 1) execution plan for top 2 improvements, 2) at least 1 documented coaching conversation, 3) early hiring/orchestration notes. Mentor task: observe a 1:1 and provide written feedback.
- Day 90 deliverables: 1) 90-day narrative (evidence-backed), 2) promotion/leveling recommendation (if applicable), 3) final mentor sign-off & next steps.

Mentor journal template (daily quick prompts — 3–5 minutes):
- Date:
- Primary observation (one sentence):
- Evidence captured (links or short notes):
- One thing manager did well today (concrete):
- One coaching suggestion for tomorrow (concrete):
- Risk signal? (yes/no + why):
- Action owner + due date:

Weekly reflection for manager (to be shared with mentor):
- Wins: 3 bullets with metrics or artifacts.
- Biggest blocker: description + proposed mitigation.
- Development ask: what skill they want to practice next week.

Sample coaching micro-exercise (15–20 min roleplay):
- Scenario: direct report missed a committed delivery and blames dependencies.
- Task: manager conducts a coaching conversation focused on accountability + root cause.
- Scoring focus: empathy, clarity on expectations, next steps, follow-up plan.
- Evidence: recording or notes + plan tracked in ticketing system.

Handover template (for hiring manager -> mentor):
- Candidate strengths (3):
- Candidate risks (3):
- Early focus areas (top 3):
- Recommended first 1:1 agenda (30 min):
- Access or org blockers to resolve before Day 1:

Offer-language suggestions (to include in offer packet):
- Mentor assignment and scheduled 1:1 cadence for first 90 days.
- Mandatory manager development plan (MVP) with quarterly checkpoints.
- Clear expectations on probationary signals and success metrics.

Evidence capture & artifacts (minimal set):
- 2 coaching snippets (email or doc), 1 decision memo, 1 roadmap snapshot, 1 team health metric export.
- Attach to the candidate's People Ops folder within 90 days.

Signals & escalation (when mentor should escalate to People Ops):
- Repeated inability to run a 1:1 (no follow-up across 3 weeks).
- Defensive or punitive behavior in coaching conversations.
- Missed mandatory compliance or payroll steps.

Open questions & next steps (working):
- Do we require a mandatory peer-moderated coaching observation in week 4? (Pros/cons).
- Should mentor journal live in People Ops Notion page or manager's personal doc? (privacy tradeoffs).
- Pilot plan: propose running this pack with 6 promotions in Q2 to validate signals and iterate scoring.

Appendix A — Suggested interview questions (quick list):
- Tell me about a time you had to reassign work mid-sprint — what changed and how did you communicate it?
- Describe a time you helped a teammate improve materially. What was the approach and evidence?
- How do you measure team health? Show one example you used before.
- Walk me through a difficult prioritization decision and the tradeoffs you considered.

Appendix B — Quick templates (short):
- 1:1 agenda template: (1) quick pulse (2) progress vs goals (3) blockers (4) coaching moment (5) action items.
- Coaching note: Situation, Behavior, Impact, Next steps, Follow-up date.

Doc owner notes: This is a living working doc. For pilot cohort, capture mentor journals in a shared folder and evaluate common risk signals after 6 people.

End of document.
